name: proot-app
description: Template: app Android (Capacitor) + Ubuntu em PRoot + servidor Python

scripts.build: npm run build -w capacitor-proot-runtime && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:android
